title: TooFast config
description: The config file of TooFast. Patterns are relative to the config file.

$schema.description: The path or the URL of this schema, so editors can validate the config file.

setupFilePatterns.description: Glob patterns of modules that are loaded before each test file.

testFilePatterns.description: Glob patterns of test files. Files in node_modules are never run.

testOptions.description: Default test options of all tests. Options passed to describe(), test() and measure() override them.

measureTimeout.description: The maximum duration of a measure in milliseconds, not counting warmup. When it's reached, the measure stops even if targetRme isn't reached yet.

targetRme.description: The relative margin of error at which the measure stops, between 0 and 1. For example, 0.05 stops the measure when the mean call duration is known within ±5% at 95% confidence.

minBatchCount.description: The minimum number of batches before targetRme can stop the measure. A few batches may agree by chance, for example, while the CPU is changing its frequency. measureTimeout still stops the measure if it's reached first.

maxWarmupBatchIterationCount.description: The maximum number of calls during warmup. V8 optimizes a function after it has been called many times, so warmup keeps slow unoptimized calls out of the results. Warmup is also limited by batchTimeout and maxBatchIterationCount. Set to 0 to skip warmup.

maxBatchIterationCount.description: The maximum number of calls in a batch, including untimed calls that measure memory and calibrate loops. Set it if beforeBatch prepares data for a limited number of calls. Unlimited by default.

batchTimeout.description: The maximum duration of a batch in milliseconds. A batch always times at least one loop, even if that loop takes longer.

batchPauseDuration.description: The pause after each batch in milliseconds. It gives the garbage collector time to run between batches instead of during them.

minLoopDuration.description: The minimum duration of a timed loop in milliseconds. A fast callback is called many times in a loop that is timed as a whole, so the overhead and resolution of the timer don't distort results. Loops are shorter if maxBatchIterationCount is too small, and have a single call if there are beforeIteration or afterIteration hooks.

maxBatchMemorySampleCount.description: The maximum number of memory samples in a batch. A memory sample is an extra call after a loop, which measures how many bytes the callback allocates instead of how long it takes. Set to 0 to skip measuring memory.

durationUnit.description: The unit of durations in results: hertz shows how many times per second a function runs (larger is better), and second shows how long a call takes (smaller is better).

percentiles.description: Percentiles of call durations to show in results, between 0 and 100. Each percentile is shown in a separate column in durationUnit.
